nantesduchateau.name: Castle of the Dukes of Brittany
nantesduchateau.slogan: Walk the ramparts where Brittany's dukes held court.
nantesduchateau.line: Founded in 1207 by Guy of Thouars, the castle was rebuilt in 1466 and now holds the Nantes history museum.

grandelephantnantes.name: Grand Éléphant
grandelephantnantes.slogan: A 12-metre elephant that strolls along the Loire.
grandelephantnantes.line: Made from 45 tons of wood and steel, it is 12 metres high, 8 metres wide and carries passengers on its back.

passagepommeraye.name: Passage Pommeraye
passagepommeraye.slogan: Iron, glass and a grand stair, shopping since 1843.
passagepommeraye.line: The shape of a city changes faster, alas, than a mortal's heart.
passagepommeraye.by: Charles Baudelaire, Le Cygne, 1857; title source of Julien Gracq's book on Nantes

puydufou.name: Puy du Fou
puydufou.slogan: A day of knights, Vikings and fireworks in the Vendée.
puydufou.line: Its night show, the Cinéscénie, has run since 1978 with about 1,200 actors, all volunteers from local villages.

goispassage.name: Passage du Gois
goispassage.slogan: A road to Noirmoutier that the sea takes back twice a day.
goispassage.line: The 4.125 km causeway is flooded at every high tide, and a crash on it split the 1999 Tour de France peloton by six minutes.
